paragraphs.label: Mở thư và mục đích
paragraphs.text:
Dear Ms Brown,

I am writing to complain about a digital learning workshop, which I attended at the community centre. Unfortunately, the service did not meet the expectations set out in the information provided before I booked.
paragraphs.noteVi: Dịch vụ, nơi và mục đích phàn nàn.

parts.text: Dear
Ms Brown
parts.labelVi: danh xưng và họ người nhận

parts.text:
,

I am writing to complain about
a digital learning workshop
parts.labelVi: sự kiện / hoạt động

parts.text: , which I attended at
the community centre
parts.labelVi: địa điểm

parts.text: . Unfortunately, the service did not meet the expectations set out in the information provided before I booked.

paragraphs.template:
Dear [danh xưng và họ người nhận],

I am writing to complain about [sự kiện / hoạt động], which I attended at [địa điểm]. Unfortunately, the service did not meet the expectations set out in the information provided before I booked.

paragraphs.label: Hai vấn đề
paragraphs.text: The first problem was that there was almost no time for the advertised practical activity. In addition, the session started forty minutes late without an explanation. I had expected a practical opportunity to try a phone-based research task and discuss classroom rules, so these problems were particularly disappointing.
